insight: Crowdfunded as 'Friend'; renamed Omi after Avi Schiffmann's rival Friend bought the friend.com domain for $1.8M.
name: Omi
tagline: Open-source AI wearable that captures conversations and turns them into notes, tasks, and recall.
description: Omi is an open-source AI wearable from Based Hardware: an $89 pendant that listens to your conversations and screen, then transcribes them and generates summaries, action items, and a searchable memory through a companion app. The hardware and software are fully open source, so you can self-host the backend, bring your own model keys, and avoid the mandatory monthly cloud subscription most AI pendants charge. A developer community has built hundreds of apps on top of the platform.

modelSupport.notes: Open source — hosted app uses cloud LLMs plus Deepgram/Whisper transcription, but you can self-host and bring your own model keys.

edge: Open-source app and open hardware — run on-device with your own keys and skip the $20–30/month cloud subscription rival AI pendants charge.
pros: Open hardware, not just open software
cons: Hardware often preorder / out of stock
Hosted features still use third-party LLMs

references.title: Omi, a competitor to Friend, wants to boost productivity using AI
